notes.title: Amazing students!
notes.notes:
They won the Emerging Talent Award at UQAM's Educational Research Popularization Competition (CVRÉ) by presenting the study that will evaluate the effects of Space Tow Truck on the learning of physics at the college level. Wow! As student researchers, they also brilliantly collected and compiled the data from this study. All this in parallel with their studies in high school teaching! 

I'm really proud that this great project, in partnership with researchers at UQAM, has generated so much involvement and creativity. 

The next generation of high school science teachers is inspiring! Congratulations Maude Lefebvre and Jeanne Benoit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/32607acca98504b851812756c1734bc22fdf0d1d.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Tow Truck will be used as part of a research project!
notes.notes:
It's a start! This fall, Space Tow Truck will be used as part of a research project!

To date, no research has focused on the effects of an educational game on physics learning in CEGEP. The results of this study by UQAM researchers (Patrick Chartrand, Martin Riopel and Stéphane Cyr) could therefore help determine the relevance and limitations of games for pre-university physics courses. 

We are therefore very proud to contribute to the advancement of knowledge in science didactics!

notes.title: Researchers at UQAM will use our game!
notes.notes:
Excellent news! Researchers at UQAM will use Space Tow Truck to evaluate the effects of an educational game on the learning and motivation of college students!   🤩

We can't wait to see the results of this research since several studies already suggest that, with children, educational games have a positive impact on science learning and that these can even help learners with learning disabilities! 😊

notes.title: Puzzle Mode Update!
notes.notes:
The puzzle mode is for people who especially like solving puzzles. The narration is greatly reduced and is limited, essentially, to giving information about the mechanics of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/b50472ab396a6e31530ca58b99196ae6744f4c7b.png[/img]

In this mode, all levels are accessible from the start and the difficulty level of each level is clearly indicated. The person playing can therefore decide to do the puzzles in any order they wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/f9ab8eb2fdf3ff2327c3d6188d3672087a72997f.png[/img]

A preview of each level is also available by clicking on the difficulty level.
